text.en:
Section 316, sub-paragraph (e) of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as
"Sec. 316. Persons bondable in discretion of the Commission on Audit. The fidelity of the following officers
shall be insured in the fidelity fund only when the Commission on Audit, shall in its discretion so direct;
"(e) Officers whose accountability is in an amount less than two thousand pesos."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
